name: bub1b_published_alleles
built_by: hand curation from full texts (commands in entry 149)
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: every BUB1B missense allele with a reported protein-level readout, from the full texts listed as inputs; evidence = a sentence copied verbatim from the text (whitespace-normalised); class: abundance-lowering (protein level reduced), stable (not reduced), ambiguous (qualitative trend, mRNA also reduced). primary = yes only for alleles found in MVA patients (the pre-registered H083 set).

searched_not_labelled.15475955 Hanks 2004: not in PMC; its missense alleles are the ones Suijkerbuijk 2010 (same group) assayed
searched_not_labelled.16411201 Matsuura 2006: not in PMC; abstract reports one missense family without an allele-level protein readout; full text not accessed
searched_not_labelled.35804254 Pavone 2022: one missense allele (PMC9616775 read); no protein-level readout
searched_not_labelled.32884756 Lin 2020: full text PMC7455400 read; no allele-level protein readout

licence: facts extracted from publications (allele names, classes, short quoted sentences for citation); PMC2887387 is a UKPMC author manuscript available for text mining
patient_data: none. Published alleles of other people only. Whether the child's allele is among them is recorded in entry 149 as yes/no, not by name.
